evals.prompt: Check which DI framework and state-management pattern this Android app uses before I add a new feature.
evals.expected_output: A per-category report with consistency percentages and a match/conflict/adopt verdict for DI and state.
expectations: Runs detection sweeps for DI and state categories
Reports a consistency percentage per category
Applies the 80/20 matrix: >=80% match existing, 50-79% conflict, <50% adopt best practice

evals.expected_output: Re-detected testing patterns, ignoring any cache.
expectations: Ignores cached results and re-runs the detection
Recommends fakes first, mocks only for final framework classes when no dominant pattern exists

evals.prompt: aet check — audit pattern consistency across the whole project
evals.expected_output: A full report across all seven categories ending with a summary.
expectations: Covers state, DI, testing, architecture, security, performance and accessibility
Ends with a summary listing categories checked, conflicts and recommended actions
